launch_slurm_job: submit a SLURM job using submitit AutoExecutor with a DictConfig and log directory
launch_local_job: launch a local distributed job using torch elastic or single process mode
run_slurm_spmd_program: execute a SPMD program entrypoint on SLURM with checkpointable runner or reducer support
map_job_config_to_dist_config: convert a JobConfig into a distributed training config dict with world size and backend
remove_runner_state_from_submission: decouple a submitted job from runner state to prevent re-submission on node failure
